title: Belltower current status
description: public/status.json: the current state of each component, written every minute by decide(). Compatible within a major version: fields are only added.

writtenAt.description: When decide() wrote this file. Older than 10 minutes means the monitor itself has stopped.

overall.description: The worst state of any component.

components.description: Components with a public check in the incident.

regions.description: The regions checks run from. A region whose lastResultsAt is more than five minutes older than writtenAt has stopped writing results.

lastResultsAt.description: When its newest run finished; null when it has never written results.

state.description: Shown in words: Operational, Degraded performance, Partial outage, Major outage, Maintenance.
